shared_elements: curvilinear engraved motifs in low relief
circular/disc motif (A) vs rounded head forms (B)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, outline-carved anthropomorphic imagery reduced to simple curvilinear strokes, and both include rounded head-like forms with stick-like limbs, which gives some stylistic kinship in level of abstraction. But A depicts a single large frontal figure with a face, a prominent central disc on the chest and belt-like horizontal bands, while B shows several small scattered stick-figures with splayed limbs among stray lines, so the specific motifs, their relationships and their layout do not correspond.
